min_annular_ring.quote: Min. Via hole size/diameter 0.15/0.25mm ... Via diameter should be 0.1mm(0.15mm preferred) larger than Via hole size.
min_annular_ring.derived: (0.25 - 0.15) / 2: the via ring the published hole and diameter leave
min_annular_ring.note: This is the VIA ring, the one rule synthesis sizes vias with. Plated component holes need far more: 'PTH annular ring ≧0.20mm ... Multilayer: 1 oz: Recommended 0.20 mm or above; absolute minimum 0.15 mm'.

min_hole_to_hole.note: Between plated component holes the page asks for more: 'Pad Hole-to-Hole Spacing 0.45mm'.
